original_test_intent: Verify the switch voltage-regulator thermal resource across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, with identity, description, reading, units, health and freshness mapped to the correct regulator domain and approved VR SPEC.
original_method: Prove common target identity; document switch power topology and TEMP_SW_VR regulator/rail/aggregation mapping; collect full command views and protected Web evidence in a bounded interval; normalize fields and compare to regulator limits without clearing logs or modifying switch, rail, SDR or cooling controls.
manual_activity: A power/platform reviewer approves the switch-regulator rail/phase/aggregation map and limits, then confirms the Web row and cross-view result.
safety_requirements: Do not alter switch or VR configuration/rails/phases
Capture complete lists and Web context
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and switch power topology
Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
engineer_actions: Approve regulator map, aggregation and SPEC

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The exact OOB name can cross-check one resource, but truncated SDR and no IB/Web evidence cannot establish five-view coverage or the physical regulator domain.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture complete command views and protected Web evidence only after binding TEMP_SW_VR to documented switch rails/regulators and aggregation behavior.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five-view source coverage and timing remain; generic clear, truncation and ASIC substitution are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Attach rail/phase/regulator membership, aggregation rule, load context and five timestamped representations to the TEMP_SW_VR evidence object.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds electrical-domain identity and explicitly excludes switch ASIC junction semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A valid switch-chip temperature or a VR reading from the wrong rail may look plausible but use a different limit.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: One aggregate VR resource may legitimately cover multiple phases or both switches only when the platform SPEC documents it.

project_override_considerations: Define switch VR components, rails/phases, aggregation, telemetry source, limits and tolerance. Prior Web-only review is historical guidance, not execution evidence for this source row.
expected_evidence: Switch power topology and TEMP_SW_VR domain map
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Protected Web row and page context
No-switch/VR/SDR/thermal mutation or log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target switch VR temperature across five views. Generic clear and incomplete DeepSeek collection are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Regulator mapping, aggregation, access and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if the resource cannot be distinguished from ASIC or other VR domains after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Separates regulator thermals from switch silicon and upgrades the earlier Web-only concept to this source-required five-interface correlation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Regulator and switch-ASIC temperatures respond to different loss mechanisms and have different limits. A generic switch grep may return both, so an electrical-domain map and telemetry-source binding are necessary before a five-view comparison can establish regulator health.
